title: Observability & Monitoring
intro: Observability interviews test whether you can debug a distributed system you can't see into. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the three pillars — structured logging, metrics (Micrometer), and distributed tracing — then the visualization layer (Prometheus and Grafana). Health checks and alerting are the production tier, then APM tools and log aggregation. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
